requirements.statement: A Visitor can open the web app and see a static Hello, World! greeting rendered on screen

criteria.must: Opening the web app displays a greeting on screen without requiring sign-in
The displayed greeting text is exactly "Hello, World!"

requirements.statement: A Developer can call the greeting API directly and receive the static greeting

criteria.must: A direct GET request to the greeting endpoint returns HTTP 200
The response body contains the exact message "Hello, World!"
The endpoint is reachable without any authentication or API key
